honesty: Every entry is a real, publicly available technology with its official source. Descriptions state what the provider itself offers. No invented statistics. Costs are stated honestly, including where 'free' means a free tier.

technologies.name: SAYouth.mobi
technologies.problem: I need work but have no money for data
technologies.description: A zero-rated national youth employment platform — free to use without data on South African networks. Job seekers create a profile, get matched to opportunities, and access work-seeker support.
technologies.cost: Free (zero-rated: no data cost on SA networks)

technologies.name: Kolibri
technologies.problem: I need learning materials but have no internet
technologies.description: An open-source offline learning platform from Learning Equality. Content is downloaded once (at a school, library or community centre) and then used entirely offline.

technologies.name: Khan Academy
technologies.description: A non-profit offering free courses in maths, science, computing, economics and more, with practice exercises and progress tracking.

technologies.name: Siyavula
technologies.problem: I am struggling with maths or science at school
technologies.description: A South African practice platform for maths and science aligned to the CAPS curriculum, with step-by-step feedback on answers.
technologies.cost: Free tier available; full access paid

technologies.name: freeCodeCamp
technologies.problem: I want coding skills but bootcamps cost thousands
technologies.description: A non-profit with a free, self-paced coding curriculum — from HTML to Python and machine learning — with free certifications.

technologies.name: Harvard CS50
technologies.problem: I want a world-class computer science education for free
technologies.description: Harvard's introduction to computer science, free to audit online — the same lectures, problem sets and final project as enrolled students.

technologies.name: Duolingo
technologies.problem: I want to learn a language but cannot pay for classes
technologies.description: Free gamified language learning with daily lessons, streaks and placement tests across dozens of languages.
technologies.cost: Free tier (ads); paid tier removes ads

technologies.name: EskomSePush
technologies.problem: Load shedding keeps surprising me and my business
technologies.description: A South African app that shows load-shedding schedules for your area with push notifications, so households and businesses can plan ahead.

technologies.name: MomConnect
technologies.problem: I am pregnant and cannot afford private healthcare advice
technologies.description: A South African National Department of Health programme that registers pregnancies at clinics and sends free stage-based maternal health messages via SMS and WhatsApp.

technologies.name: SADAG helplines
technologies.problem: I need mental health support but cannot afford therapy
technologies.description: The South African Depression and Anxiety Group runs free telephonic counselling helplines, including a 24-hour suicide crisis line, plus referrals to free resources.

technologies.name: Namola
technologies.problem: In an emergency I do not know who will actually come
technologies.description: A South African emergency app that sends your GPS location to a response centre which dispatches the nearest responders — built for where street addresses fail.
technologies.cost: Free tier; optional paid responder plans

technologies.name: WhatsApp Business
technologies.problem: My small business has no online presence and no budget for a website
technologies.description: A free business app with a product catalogue, business profile, quick replies and labels — a shopfront on the platform customers already use.

technologies.name: Google Business Profile
technologies.problem: Customers nearby cannot find my business
technologies.description: A free listing that puts a business on Google Search and Maps with hours, photos, reviews and directions.

technologies.name: CIPC eServices
technologies.problem: I want to register my company properly without paying an agent
technologies.description: The Companies and Intellectual Property Commission's online portal lets you register a private company from home for the official fee — no middleman needed.

technologies.name: PayShap
technologies.problem: Cash is risky and EFTs are slow and costly
technologies.description: South Africa's instant payment service — send money between banks in seconds using a cellphone number (ShapID), offered through participating banks' apps.

technologies.name: Yoco
technologies.problem: My business loses customers who only carry cards
technologies.description: Card payment acceptance for small businesses — buy an affordable card machine or use payment links, with per-transaction fees and no monthly rental on entry options.
technologies.cost: Per-transaction fee; hardware from a low once-off price

technologies.name: SnapScan
technologies.problem: I want to accept payments at a market stall without a card machine
technologies.description: QR-code payments: customers scan your code with the app and pay from their phone. Merchants pay a per-transaction fee; no hardware needed.
technologies.cost: Free for customers; merchant fee per transaction

technologies.name: Legal Aid SA
technologies.problem: I have a legal problem but cannot afford a lawyer
technologies.description: A state-funded body providing free legal representation and advice to people who cannot afford it, subject to a means test — including criminal, civil and labour matters.

technologies.name: SA Weather Service
technologies.problem: I farm and weather surprises destroy my planning
technologies.description: The official South African Weather Service — free forecasts, severe-weather warnings and agricultural advisories via web and app.
